confirmed_defect: A one-shot on_begin registration accepts native Invalid (-1). Multiple initially unassigned actors overwrite that entry and are never registered under their later IDs.
reproduction: Real B1 Zoi callbacks begin two actors with ID -1, assign distinct valid IDs and tick. The old code fails before retry: Invalid is already present in the registry.
fix: Refuse negative/non-numeric IDs; the bound actor retries on_tick only until registration succeeds.
Remember each registered actor's ID for ownership-safe teardown after a native ID reset.
Retain bounded requested-failure diagnostics; include registered versus current native identities and deferred-register call count. No per-frame diagnostic writes.

regressions: Several initially unassigned actors recover independently.
Stable actors do not repeat registration.
Unloading after native ID reset releases the original registration.
Late old-object cleanup retains a replacement.
